response:

1. Student Management:
- Students ki details add, search aur manage karna
- Class-wise student list dekhna
- Student ka gender aur roll number track karna

2. Fee Management:
- School ka overall fee collection summary
- Class-wise ya individual student ki fees (paid, pending, total)
- Pending fees track karna

3. Attendance Management:
- Individual student ki attendance
- Class-wise attendance
- School-wide attendance
- Date ya date range ke hisaab se attendance dekhna

4. Exams and Marks:
- School ke saare exams ki list aur dates
- Student ke exam results (pass/fail, percentage, grade, rank)
- Subject-wise detailed marks
- Class-wise marks dekhna

5. Staff and Teachers:
- Staff members ki list aur designations
- Staff summary (counts by designation)
- Teachers ki class/section assignments

6. Classes and Sections:
- School ki saari classes aur sections ki list
- Class search karna

7. ERP Help Guide:
- Software use karne ke "how-to" sawaalon ke answers
